summary: Comprehensive Master Completion Report for Phase 30 of the Phumulani AI Community Platform. Details the resolution of the GitHub Pages blank screen, completion of the 15-section public website and permissioned CMS, expansion of the Community Member Portal (M30.06), 15-stage volunteer lifecycle (M30.07), Donor Giving and Payment Gateway (M30.08), MEAL and Grants (M30.09), Staff and Board Governance (M30.10), 36 AI Workforce agents (M30.11), Communications and OAuth (M30.12), Safeguarding under VAWA Section 1367 and WCAG 2.2 AA (M30.13), Hosting, Monitoring and Disaster Recovery (M30.14), and 100% pass of all 425 automated acceptance tests (M30.15).
